history.name: A feature is its own history
history.description: Each feature in the record carries every version of itself, and a version only appears in that history when something about the feature actually changed — an absent version means it was still whatever the last entry said. So the record is a list of the moments that mattered rather than a full snapshot per release, and the question "what did this look like at version 4?" always has an answer, which is what lets an edition from a year ago still reproduce exactly what was presented that day.
history.dev_notes: src/model/feature.mjs — Feature#stateAt(version) walks history up to the target and returns the last entry; #touchedAt is the mechanical New/Changed test.
